[attribute-y-size]
=== `@y-size` Y Size of the Glyph

The number of rows in the bit-mapped glyph that has been declared with a <<element-glyph-data,`<glyph-data>`>> element as part of a <<element-private-char,`<private-char>`>> element.

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-glyph-data,`<glyph-data>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Number| The number of rows (for example, “`25`”) used to
                        define the glyph in a <<element-glyph-data,`<glyph-data>`>>
                        element.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
